{"body_md": "## Problem
Claims payments are delayed because third-party bank details cannot be verified before processing, leading to reissues and frustrated policyholders. This affects cash flow and reporting accuracy.

## Who is affected
- **Insurance carriers** who issue payments to third-party suppliers, repairers, or other vendors, and who cannot validate bank details ahead of time, causing bounced payments and rework [i:0810d33b7befd9dc][i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37][i:3a68dd3a6f3ff801].
- **Policyholders** who experience delays in claims resolution due to payment reissuance [i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4][i:e9c7f9b651cb8ad6].
- **Finance and reporting teams** whose reserves and supplier reporting are negatively impacted by the rework and delays [i:26f44575b6dac473][i:9bd19c6494c50ad9].

## Evidence
- The problem has been mentioned 22 times across 9 accounts [i:0810d33b7befd9dc][i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37][i:3a68dd3a6f3ff801].
- Mentions came through three routes: sales (7 mentions), support (12 mentions), and account management (3 mentions) [i:4d10f0a8fa0b09ff][i:4204829429da678e][i:61c8fd8956849053].
- The combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of the affected accounts is £4,846,000.0 [i:03f272ecc7cd6170][i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4][i:61c8fd8956849053].
- Two accounts have renewed in the last 90 days [i:c9e3db7d4874d791][i:e9937b8271f56bf2].
- Pendleford Motor Mutual (ARR £690,000.0) states, We’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time — it’s causing reissues and unhappy policyholders [i:0810d33b7befd9dc].
- Brantwick Commercial (ARR £150,000.0) explains, when we send payments to third parties, the bank info isn’t verified ahead of time... payment detail checking isn’t happening before funds go out, so we’re stuck reissuing failed payments days later [i:5195e479ae636965].
- Thistlecombe Mutual (ARR £980,000.0) says, We’re struggling because we can’t verify third-party payee bank details before sending payments — it forces us to reissue failed payments days later, which delays claims resolution for policyholders [i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4].
- Holloway Reach Underwriting (ARR £320,000.0) reports, We’re running into delays because the payee account verification step isn’t happening before the payment is sent out, which causes rework and client frustration [i:a16c8653e17d2f9e].
- Marrowgate Commercial (ARR £1,600,000.0) notes, We’ve also noticed that payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays and affecting our supplier timelines [i:61c8fd8956849053].
- Ravensgill Insurance (ARR £470,000.0) states, we can’t verify third-party bank info before paying — so payments bounce and we reissue days later [i:ea91ae3bee7a144d].

## Why now
- The issue is actively causing payment delays and rework, with multiple accounts reporting it through support and sales channels in recent months [i:0810d33b7befd9dc][i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4][i:61c8fd8956849053].
- Two high-value accounts, Marrowgate Commercial (renewal 2026-12-12) and Elderfold Home (renewal 2026-12-21), are approaching renewal, and the problem is affecting their operations and supplier relationships [i:61c8fd8956849053][i:c9e3db7d4874d791].
- Accounts are explicitly linking the inability to verify bank details to impacts on cash flow, reserves, and reporting accuracy, indicating a growing operational and financial urgency [i:26f44575b6dac473][i:9bd19c6494c50ad9][i:e9c7f9b651cb8ad6].", "citations": ["i:0810d33b7befd9dc", "i:1a5ecfa9cdb48b37", "i:3a68dd3a6f3ff801", "i:4d8a57c2f228cdb4", "i:e9c7f9b651cb8ad6", "i:26f44575b6dac473", "i:9bd19c6494c50ad9", "i:4d10f0a8fa0b09ff", "i:4204829429da678e", "i:61c8fd8956849053", "i:03f272ecc7cd6170", "i:c9e3db7d4874d791", "i:e9937b8271f56bf2", "i:5195e479ae636965", "i:a16c8653e17d2f9e", "i:ea91ae3bee7a144d"]}
